description: This file defines a Router class for handling HTTP routing in a PHP web application. It manages route registration for GET and POST requests, static file serving, fallback views, and request dispatching based on URL patterns and HTTP methods.

classes.name: Router
classes.description: A class providing static methods to register routes, serve static files, set fallback views, and run the routing process for incoming HTTP requests.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Registers a GET route with a specified path and controller, supporting array-based controllers for class methods.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Registers a POST route with a specified path and controller.

methods.name: static
methods.description: Sets a static file directory path for serving static assets, throws an exception if the path does not exist.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Sets a fallback view or handler for unmatched routes.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Dispatches incoming HTTP requests to the appropriate route handler based on method and URL pattern, serving static files, handling errors, and invoking controllers.
